session_summary: Session 3 was a follow-up wellbeing check-in where the student reported partial completion of the previous between-session task (starting but not finishing the pause routine due to scheduling conflicts). The main barrier remains the uncertainty about the nature/duration of the problem and conflicting home/school timing constraints. A new in-session activity involved rehearsing a help request with a trusted school adult, which the student found useful for clarifying options but noted that the wider barrier has not disappeared. No external support was delivered or confirmed.
primary_concern: Uncertainty about whether the lack of interest/engagement is temporary; difficulty planning due to unclear circumstances and timing conflicts; partial completion of agreed tasks.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task from Session 2: Try a brief grounding/pause routine during one stressful school moment.
New agreed between-session task: Check when the trusted adult is available and rehearse a help request.
Student request to keep private family details out of summaries and avoid assuming the problem is resolved.

next_steps: Student to attempt checking the trusted adult's availability and rehearsing a help request.

Monitor if student gets stuck and requires teacher assistance for procedures.
uncertainties: Whether the lack of interest in activities is temporary or persistent.

Causal link between delivered check-in support and any future improvement in attendance or engagement.
conclusion: The wellbeing check-in was delivered as a supportive conversation, establishing rapport and identifying practical steps. The student found the session helpful for clarifying options but explicitly noted that external support has not been automatically delivered. Uncertainty regarding the nature of the problem remains unresolved, and no evidence yet supports improvement in attendance or engagement.
